title: refactor(console): lazy-load metadata in MetadataProvider
body:
## Fix "Object Not Found" / "Rendered more hooks" regression on app entry

### Repro (verified in browser via Playwright)
1. Sign up / log in.
2. Navigate to `/console/apps/<app>/<object>` (e.g. `/apps/crm_enterprise/contact`).
3. Before the fix: app crashes with `ErrorBoundary` → _"Something went wrong / Rendered more hooks than during the previous render."_

### Root cause
The Phase 1 lazy-loading refactor made `useMetadata().objects` return `[]` on first read while the lazy fetch was in flight, then re-render with the populated array. `ObjectView.tsx` does `const objectDef = objects.find(...)` then early-returns `<Empty/>` when undefined — **with `useMemo` / `useCallback` / `useEffect` hooks after that early return that reference `objectDef`**. When `objects` transitioned from `[]` to populated, the hook count grew mid-lifecycle → React error #310.

### Fix (minimal, sustainable)
`AppContent` now awaits `ensureType('object' | 'dashboard' | 'report' | 'page')` before rendering the routes under `/apps/:appName/*`. Legacy components that assume "metadata is fully loaded by render time" continue to work unchanged. `/home`, `/login`, `/register` do not go through `AppContent`, so the Phase 1 benefit (boot fetches only the `app` list) is preserved.

`ensureType` is defensively defaulted when destructured so the 18+ existing test files that provide partial `useMetadata()` mocks keep compiling without touching any of them.

### Plan
- [x] Verify the failure in-browser (captured "Rendered more hooks" via Playwright, `ObjectView.tsx:301` early-return followed by `useMemo` at `:320`, etc.).
- [x] Preload the `object` / `dashboard` / `report` / `page` buckets in `AppContent`.
- [x] Re-run the browser flow — `/apps/crm_enterprise/contact`, `/apps/crm_enterprise/account` render cleanly, no ErrorBoundary.
- [x] Run the console test suite: **65 files / 891 passed / 1 skipped** (same baseline as before the fix).
- [x] Update `CHANGELOG.md` under `Unreleased → Fixed`.

Layer 3 (per-component migration to `useMetadataItem`) remains the proper long-term architectural fix and is tracked as follow-up work; this PR is the minimal correctness fix that keeps Phase 1's bootstrap benefit intact while unblocking every `/apps/:appName/*` route.
